title: Beyond the Rankings: Travel & Tourism Development Index 2026
text:
Go to seriesAgenda DialoguesBeyond the Rankings: Travel & Tourism Development Index 2026What lies beyond the rankings? Grounded in the findings of the 2026 Travel & Tourism Development Index, this webinar unpacks the structural shifts shaping tourism competitiveness across more than 100 economies. The discussion explores where progress is accelerating, where vulnerabilities persist and what the findings mean for policy, investment and destination strategy.This is the full audio from a live-streamed video session available to watch for World Economic Forum partners and digital members who can watch it here.Guests:Ramya KrishnaswamyHead of Institutional Communities; Executive Committee Member, World Economic ForumCara MortonCEO Global Businesses and Operations and Member of the Executive Committee, Zurich Insurance GroupHawazen NassiefDeputy Minister for International Relations, Ministry of Tourism of Saudi ArabiaShare:More episodes:PodcastsAuthentic Leadership Revisited: What Drives Real Impact?10 hr. agoPodcastsChief Economists OutlookSep 22, 2026PodcastsAgeing as an AssetSep 21, 2026PodcastsFrom $100 Oil to Extreme Heat: Can Technology Reduce Energy Vulnerability?Sep 14, 2026Forum Stories newsletterBringing you weekly curated insights and analysis on the global issues that matter.Subscribe today
